title: 司机称开启智驾后打瞌睡，江西泉南高速车辆撞防撞沙桶侧翻
title_en: Driver reports using assistance before Jiangxi expressway rollover
content: 【侧翻在地连连打转！司机：“我开了智驾，有点瞌睡，它就撞了”】2026年8月23日，泉南高速江西永新段。一辆小车在快车道行驶至弯道路段时，忽然向左前方偏离车道，撞上中央护栏处放置的防撞沙桶。伴随着沙土飞扬，小车当场侧翻在地并连续转了将近两圈，最后停在了应急车道上。司机告诉交警：“我开了智驾，有点打瞌睡，它就撞上去了。”原来，司机上高速后开启了车辆的“智驾”功能，行驶过程中犯困打起了瞌睡，从而导致事故。交警提醒：当前车辆所配备的“智驾”，从技术特征来说是“智能辅助驾驶”系统，本质是“辅助驾驶”而不是自动驾驶！广大驾驶人在购买有“智能辅助驾驶”功能的车辆时，应详细了解交互逻辑、操作规范、禁用场景；在使用此功能时，必须全程保持驾驶位值守，双手控稳方向盘，实时监测路况动态，确保车辆处于可控状态，不得“脱手脱眼”，不得有酒后驾驶、疲劳驾驶、分心驾驶等违法行为。
content_en: Wuhan traffic police reported that on 23 August 2026 a car veered left on a curve of the Quannan Expressway near Yongxin, Jiangxi, struck impact barrels at the median, rolled, and stopped on the emergency shoulder. The driver told police they had activated a driver-assistance feature and had become drowsy. The post does not identify the vehicle brand or state whether anyone was injured.
author: 武汉交警
english_description: Wuhan traffic police reported a 23 August rollover on the Quannan Expressway in Jiangxi. The driver said they had enabled driver assistance and become drowsy before the car hit impact barrels; the vehicle brand and injury outcome were not stated.
review_notes: Direct original Weibo post reviewed on 2026-09-24; ADAS relevance accepted despite negative SVM score. Incident details remain unverified.

title: 蔚来ES6自动泊车未识别地库承重柱，后视镜和漆面受损
title_en: NIO ES6 damaged during automatic parking in a garage
content: 蔚来ES6自动泊车过程中，车辆未识别地库承重柱，造成反光镜损毁、漆面刮伤。#蔚来ES6##自动泊车##事故##汽车投诉##车质网#
content_en: A post by the automotive complaint platform Car Quality Network says a NIO ES6 failed to recognize a load-bearing pillar during automatic parking in an underground garage. The incident damaged a side mirror and scratched the paint. The post does not state the incident date or garage location.
author: 车质网
english_description: Car Quality Network reported a NIO ES6 parking-assist collision with a garage pillar that damaged a mirror and paint. The incident date and location were not given.
review_notes: Direct original Weibo post reviewed on 2026-09-24; ADAS relevance accepted despite negative SVM score. Incident details remain unverified.

title: 问界M5车主称自动泊车曾剐蹭并获泊车保险赔付
title_en: AITO M5 owner reports earlier automatic-parking scrape
content: 我的赛力斯问界M5今天赠送了智驾无忧，挺不错滴。之前我自动泊车蹭到了，就用的泊车无忧险，全额赔付了。#问界##赛力斯##AITO#
content_en: An AITO M5 owner said their car had previously scraped something during automatic parking and that a parking insurance policy paid the claim in full. The post gives no date or location for the scrape.
author: 科技C先生
english_description: An AITO M5 owner reported an earlier scrape during automatic parking and said a parking insurance policy covered the loss. The incident date and location were not specified.
